result:
I added ultimate buttons, a display-pace control and a read-only card detail sheet to the server battle screen. Nothing has been compiled or run: I had no shell, so build, EditMode/PlayMode and Unity Play are all **NOT_RUN**.

**Changed file:** only `client/MemoryForgeUnity/Assets/Scripts/MemoryForgeServerPracticeClient.cs`. Earlier accepted edits are untouched, and the save, parts and node-service flows behave as before. I didn't touch Core, the server, data, rules, numbers, schema, the shared digest, scenes or dependencies, and I didn't commit.

**Agreed API, names as specified:**
- `UltAsync(string actorId)`, `ActionPace`, `SetActionPace(MemoryForgeExpeditionClient.ActionPacing)`, `CardDetailsOpen`, `OpenCardDetails()`, `CloseCardDetails()`.
- Buttons: `Ult:<actorId>`, `Pace:Normal`, `Pace:Double`, `Pace:Reduced`, `OpenCardDetails`, `CloseCardDetails`. The detail body label is `CardDetailsBody`, inside the scroll `CardDetailsScroll`.

**Ultimates:**
- `UltAsync` refuses while a presentation, pick sheet or prepared card is open, or when `CanCommand` is false. It also needs the live `PLAYER` phase with no battle result, a published actor, and that actor's published gauge at or above `gaugeMax`.
- It sends `{actor}` plus `target` only when a live enemy is selected, never picks, through the existing mutation and outbox. A `BAD_TARGET` refusal shows as "반영되지 않았어요". The gauge is never changed locally.
- The party panel still shows HP, the HP bar, block, turn, action points and pile counts in a more compact layout. Below them, every actor gets a row with name, gauge/max, a bar and its `Ult:` button. The rows scroll if there are more than three.
- Selecting an enemy already worked without a hand card. I added a hint explaining that a targeted ultimate needs an enemy picked first.

**Presentation and pace:**
- The title comes from the fresh `ult` event's actor ("○○ 필살기 결과"). Otherwise it is "턴 결과" for end turn (unchanged) and "예약 결과" or "카드 사용 결과" for plays.
- Rows now carry kind tags through `MemoryForgeExpeditionClient.ActionRowText`, in both the strip and the barrier sheet.
- Double halves every wait. Reduced shows all rows at once, but a barrier still waits for Continue. The base 0.2/0.3/0.6 s timings are unchanged.
- Changing the pace sends nothing and doesn't touch the selection or a prepared card. If the shorter wait ends the presentation sooner, the prepared card goes out through the existing `Update` rule.
- The strip now has a title, the three pace buttons, the row text and the skip button.

**Card detail:**
- Opened from "카드 설명 전체 보기" in the action panel. It asks nothing, sends nothing and changes no selection, target, mode, pick sheet or prepared card.
- Contents:
  - The current battle query's server name and full text.
  - Which source is shown.
  - Modes with cost and the default-request verdict.
  - Attached and temporary parts with their texts. An ID the client can't name is still listed as is.
  - The current forecast.
- Missing or still-loading server values are labelled as such. The text is measured to its full wrapped height and scrolls vertically, and the scroll position survives redraws.
- It closes on any change of selection generation (card, mode, enemy, pick sheet, snapshot change including the prepared card's own dispatch), on a barrier, on leaving the battle and on suspend. Its overlay blocks manual input but doesn't cancel a prepared card.

**Things to check:**
- A terminal card play's barrier title now reads "카드 사用 결과" instead of "턴 결과". No existing test reads that title.
- Barrier rows now carry tags, including "· " in front of summary rows.
- The detail API doesn't block programmatic `ConfirmAsync` or `UltAsync`; only the overlay blocks manual taps.
- I didn't show ultimate descriptions, so the "base text only" labelling never came up.
- The pace buttons are 30 px tall in the 112 px strip, and the party panel layout is tighter. Root should check both at 130% text with five enemies, plus a run-through: ultimate with one and with several enemies, each pace mode during barriers and with a prepared card, and the detail with a long card text.
- I don't have this session's `session_id`.
